In 2023 I was awarded the McKinnon Prize for Political Leadership for Emerging Political Leader. The prize included a $20,000 scholarship to further the development of leadership skills, knowledge and work contributing to the public good. Between March 29,2024 and April 12,2024 I travelled to the United States to complete a course in leadership at the Harvard Law School as part of the scholarship. All costs incurred through the course were covered by the Susan McKinnon Foundation including the cost of the course, flights, accommodation, to a total value of $18,310.66. I have also received complimentary executive coaching as part of the scholarship.
